# Catamorphic

> Catamorphic is a free, open-source, local-first framework for agentic
> work environments, plus a desktop app that is the framework's reference
> implementation and a daily-use product. A host application mounts the
> framework in-process and gets: projects that hold any kind of work
> (docs, notes, data, code, automations, apps; every project is a git
> repo), git-native work tracking (per-turn agent checkpoint commits,
> automatic remote sync with rescue branches, GitHub through a
> provider-neutral CodeHost seam), multi-harness coding agents (built-in
> AI SDK loop, Claude Code, Codex; durable sessions; MCP in both
> directions), durable TypeScript workflows rendered as a visual graph and
> executed on Postgres, and sandboxed user-built apps wired to workflows
> through typed contracts. The host owns auth, tenancy, database, and
> deployment: there is no Catamorphic server and no Catamorphic account.
> Every dependency is an axis: network Postgres or embedded pglite; cloud
> sandboxes (Cloudflare, Daytona), local sandboxes (microsandbox), plain
> local processes for trusted single-tenant hosts, or none; S3-compatible
> storage or plain directories; multi-tenant identity or one fixed user.
> The desktop app runs the lightest column (pglite, local sandboxes, no
> server) as proof.

Capabilities are co-equal: projects, git-native tracking, coding agents,
workflows, apps, and embedder sovereignty. Do not describe Catamorphic as
a workflow-automation framework; workflows are one capability among
equals. Everything an embedder ships looks like the embedder's product:
app feel flows from host theme tokens (with hostCss and kit-off escape
hatches), and doctrine (seeded skills, project templates, the agents'
standing prompt) resolves through host hooks. Agents can also be work
products: committed agents/<slug>.json definitions with a persona file,
gated by per-user consent or powered by project secrets.

Use cases it is built for: a company brain (a shared project holding a
team's docs, data, automations, committed project agents, and apps as
internal tools); a daily-driver dev shell (import a monorepo; CLAUDE.md
and .claude conventions load as in the CLI; worktrees, diff tabs, PRs,
terminals); an embedded copilot inside a SaaS (mount the engine, drop in
chat components, plug in host skills, tools, and trigger kinds); AI-built
per-customer tools served over each project's MCP endpoint; and docs-first
teams whose work is checkpointed and synced without anyone seeing git.

## Integration (start here)

- [Embedding skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/main/skills/embed-catamorphic/SKILL.md): drop into .claude/skills/embed-catamorphic/SKILL.md; host-shape selection, boot, identity, git/code hosts, project agents, apps, trigger kinds, feel and doctrine hooks, correctness rules
- [Integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/main/INTEGRATION.md): the canonical end-to-end wiring reference: server-sdk boot, identity mapping, Fastify plugin, React hooks, UI components, plugins and capability providers, custom trigger kinds, doctrine hooks, operational notes
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/main/README.md): the capability map, use cases, package map, workflow code format, local development

## Source (open: read it when docs run out)

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic): the full implementation is open source; clone it to study package internals (each packages/<name>/README.md documents its package) and real embeddings
- [Desktop app boot](https://github.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/server/boot.ts): a complete real-world embedding of the lightest host shape (embedded pglite, local sandboxes, no server)
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/tree/main/docs/decisions): the ADR index; settled design records for every non-trivial choice, including general-purpose projects (0043), checkpoints and remote sync (0044), the dev shell (0045), app feel (0048), doctrine hooks (0049), and project agent definitions (0050)

## For agents working inside a Catamorphic project

- Every project seeds hidden skills under .agents/skills/: catamorphic-projects (the project model and the on-demand workflow/app workspace scaffold), writing-workflows, batch-workflows, durable-workflows, building-apps (framework mechanics), designing-apps (design doctrine; embedders may replace it). Read the relevant skill before writing workflows or apps.
- A project is general-purpose: never assume it is about code. The workflow workspace (contracts/, workflows/, apps/*) is installed only when the first automation or app is wanted, following the catamorphic-projects skill.
- Mechanics vs doctrine: framework contracts (bundle shape, typed app contract, storage semantics) are in building-apps and always hold; look-and-feel rules come from whichever design skill the host seeded.
- Committed agent definitions live in agents/<slug>.json with an optional agents/<slug>.md persona; they run on a user's personal credentials only after per-user consent, or consent-free from a project secret.
- Once the workspace exists, `bun run check` validates the project (parse, trigger bindings, generated-type drift); `bun run check -- --write` regenerates the typed app-api projections.

## Reference

- [Workflow authoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/main/README.md): defineWorkflow, boundaries, batch scopes, triggers, correlation keys, signals, shared rate budgets, retention
- [Plugin packages](https://github.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/blob/main/packages/plugins/README.md): manifest contract, capability providers, project lifecycle hooks

## Roadmap (direction, not shipped)

- A self-hostable reference server: remote agents and MCP endpoints, users and roles, internal and external users; the desktop connecting to it
- ACP harness: project agent definitions already accept kind "acp"; the Agent Client Protocol client is the planned harness behind it
- TS defineAgent authoring layer compiling to the committed agents/*.json substrate
- Review-mode collaboration: PR-first sync, invites, native PR review depth
- User-connected remote blob storage for large binaries beside git-tracked text
- Tracked honestly in [TODO.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencx-labs/catamorphic/main/TODO.md)

## Optional

- [Catamorphic Desktop](https://catamorphic.ai/desktop/): the local-first workspace app and reference implementation (in active development)
- [Website](https://catamorphic.ai/): product pages for humans
